Student protest at Jantar Mantar ends after 36 days

A 36-day protest by the Chhatra Jagriti Manch (CJP) at Jantar Mantar concluded after its leader, Satyendra Pradhan, resigned and the government agreed to the students' pending demands. Sonam Wangchuk, who was also fasting, ended his 26-day hunger strike following government assurances. The protest involved students and supporters, with some reports highlighting the team that managed the Jantar Mantar site and the clean-up afterwards. The CJP has stated it will continue its agitation.
